data.title: search: say how much of the question a hit actually holds
data.description: 28 of 100 paraphrased questions got a confidently wrong passage instead of silence, which is the failure mode that makes a model fabricate. The planned fix was the gap between the first hit and the second; measured over the golden set it does not separate right from wrong - 0.10 against 0.08 - and a warning built on it would have fired on more than half the correct answers. Coverage does separate: 1.00 against 0.62 at the median, and across every top-three hit those at or above 0.7 are relevant 53% of the time against 21% below it. Added as a field on every hit and as a line in the human output.
